# Pronto

Pronto builds, deploys, and maintains custom AI customer service agents for Singapore SMEs.

## Positioning

Pronto is a done-for-you service, not a self-serve chatbot builder. The team handles scoping, data ingestion, brand voice configuration, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support.

## Core Offer

- AI customer service agents trained on each client's verified business sources
- Launch channels include WhatsApp and Telegram, with email, Messenger, and Instagram DMs as expansion paths
- Agents escalate to humans when an answer is not grounded, out of scope, sensitive, urgent, or better handled by the business owner
- Multilingual support covers English, Mandarin, Bahasa Melayu, and natural Singapore code-switching
- Target launch timeline is under one week after scope is locked

## Pricing

- Standard setup starts at SGD 2,500
- Custom setup starts at SGD 5,000+
- Starter is SGD 200/month
- Growth is SGD 500/month
- Scale is SGD 1,200/month
- Enterprise is custom
- Scoped paid trials are SGD 500 and credited toward setup if the client converts
